% Checks cases the fix for quantikz in display math must not break: the
% quantikz library before 1.0, loaded with \usetikzlibrary{quantikz},
% whose circuit in a center environment and in a figure is a picture.
% Each case follows a paragraph that names it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{quantikz}
\begin{document}
Old library center.
\begin{center}
\begin{quantikz} & \gate{X} & \qw \end{quantikz}
\end{center}

Old library figure.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering
\begin{quantikz} & \gate{Z} & \qw \end{quantikz}
\caption{An old circuit in a figure}
\end{figure}
\end{document}
